labelChirho: to be counted worthy, be deemed deserving (passive/middle)
descriptionChirho: Passive or middle voice: to be judged or reckoned as worthy or deserving, whether of greater glory (Heb 3:3), punishment (Heb 10:29), God's calling (2 Thess 1:11), or double honor (1 Tim 5:17).
Active voice: to deem or consider someone or something as worthy, appropriate, or fitting, involving the subject's deliberate judgment (Luke 7:7, Acts 15:38, Acts 28:22).
